name: read-file
description: Read a text file's content, paging by line range via offset/limit (default 2000 lines). Use this instead of shell cat/type for reading files — it never floods the context and truncated pages tell you the next offset to continue from. Works for code, configs, logs, and other text files.

path.description: Path to the text file to read (absolute or relative).

offset.description: 1-based line number to start reading from (default 1).

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return (default 2000). Set to 0 for no limit (large files consume many tokens).
